set.body:
Replace positional paired-row assumptions with typed evidence and operators.

Acceptance:
- Add SameEntityEvidence, ExactBijection, PartialInjection, IncidenceMap, AggregationMap, NonnegativeCoupling, ProbabilisticCoupling, SignedRowLink, and explicit named conversions.
- Add typed RowMap and RowLink with domain, codomain, orientation, support, normalization, and provenance.
- Deprecate safe constructors that infer row identity from equal row counts; positional compatibility must be visibly unsafe or assumption-bearing.
- Add EntityAlignedStudy with maps P_s to a common entity space and induced links P_s* A_E P_t.
- Certify adjoint consistency and global block PSD for hub-factorized links when the entity form is PSD.
- Report matched and unmatched mass, cardinality structure, duplicate keys, marginals, normalization, and entity coverage.
- Keep missing cells, absent views, unmatched observations, uncertain matches, exclusions, and structural zeros distinct.
- Provide exact-identity reduction to the present same-row paired formulation.
- Add sparse partial-match tests and unmatched-support zero-mass laws on JVM and Scala.js.

Non-goal: feature-learned alignment estimation and train-test fitting are deferred.
set.title: multivar constitution: explicit row relationships and hub alignment
